name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatJoinOtherServerActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen in the join-server flow. A user enters a server ID, sees the matching server, and can join it or follow the announcement-server join flow.
disableEffect: Users cannot look up and join an existing QChat server through the built-in flow.
